🇨🇳 中文说明"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"⭐ If you like this plugin, please star it on GitHub — it shows me that the plugin is useful to you a"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"nd motivates me to keep developing it."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"🐛 If you find a bug or would like to request a feature, open a GitHub issue in any language — I will"},{"id":"p6s2","text":" review your proposal and implement useful suggestions in a future plugin version."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## ⚡ Overview & The Problem"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"When coding assistants work in standard terminal or chat windows, they typically produce static code"},{"id":"p8s2","text":" snippets or markdown blocks. This creates critical friction:
1. **No Live Feedback**: Developers ca"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"nnot see or test interactivity, form validations, animations, or responsive breakpoints without manu"},{"id":"p8s4","text":"ally copying code into a local build toolchain.
2. **Context Fragmentation**: Reviewing UI changes r"},{"id":"p8s5","text":"equires switching back and forth between IDE, terminal, browser, and design tools.
3. **Verbose Text"},{"id":"p8s6","text":" Overload**: Explaining architecture, roadmaps, and wireframes in raw text produces walls of markdow"},{"id":"p8s7","text":"n that are difficult to scan."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"### The Solution: `dsh-live-canvas`
Inspired by Thariq Shihipar's *The Unreasonable Effectiveness of"},{"id":"p9s2","text":" HTML*, Plannotator, and modern visual studios (Figma, Retool, V0), **`@goodandready/dsh-live-canvas"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"`** transforms DeepSeek Harness into a complete, standalone frontend development suite. It provides "},{"id":"p9s4","text":"in-memory ESM bundling, real-time SSE hot-reloading, in-chat interactive preview cards, a split-view"},{"id":"p9s5","text":" code editor, time-travel history debugging, 1-click cloud deployment, and **30 dedicated Agent Tool"},{"id":"p9s6","text":"e editor, time-travel history debugging, 1-click cloud deployment, and **30 dedicated Agent Tools**."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## 🧭 Sidebar Layouts & Surface Compatibility"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"`@goodandready/dsh-live-canvas` supports all DSH navigation layouts with zero external dependencies:"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"| Environment | Supported Surface | Capabilities |"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"| **DSH 0.1.5-alpha.1+ (Native)** | Native Right Sidebar (`sidebarRightTabs`, `sidebar.right.pane.ta"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"b`) | Full Live Canvas workspace tab + native file viewer for `dsh-resource://file` (`.html`, `.jsx`"},{"id":"p13s3","text":", `.tsx`, `.svg`, `.mermaid`, `.md`). |
| **Legacy DSH Profiles** | `dsh-better-sidebar` integration"},{"id":"p13s4","text":" | Dedicated tab (`live-canvas`) and registered file viewer (`live-canvas-viewer`). |
| **Dual Profi"},{"id":"p13s5","text":"les (Both enabled)** | Coexists seamlessly | Distinct, deterministic IDs (`@goodandready/dsh-live-ca"},{"id":"p13s6","text":"nvas` vs `live-canvas`), no duplicate mounting, independent cleanup disposers. |
| **Minimal / Stand"},{"id":"p13s7","text":"alone Profiles** | Standalone Drawer & Modals | Self-contained slide-over drawer with hotkeys (`Alt+"},{"id":"p13s8","text":"C`), zero reliance on external sidebar plugins. |"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## 🏛️ System Architecture"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## ✨ Exhaustive Feature Breakdown
- **🏠 Projects Hub & Recent Sessions (v0.2.14)**: Dedicated dashbo"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"ard displaying all active preview sessions and workspace components (React, HTML, Vue, SVG, Markdown"},{"id":"p16s3","text":") sorted by activity, featuring instant search and 1-click loading.
- **↕️ Interactive Chat Card Res"},{"id":"p16s4","text":"izing**: Smooth vertical height resizing (160px to 800px) via drag handle, quick preset dimensions ("},{"id":"p16s5","text":"`S` 200px, `M` 320px, `L` 480px), and Wide View mode (`⤢`).
- **🔄 Dedicated In-Canvas Refresh**: Fra"},{"id":"p16s6","text":"me reload button in toolbar and support for F5 / Ctrl+R shortcuts inside the canvas frame without re"},{"id":"p16s7","text":"loading the DSH host application.
- **🛡️ Defensive Tool Output Schemas**: AI agent tools return stru"},{"id":"p16s8","text":"ctured refusal metadata (`code`, `allowedRoots`, `reason`) on path policy violations, enabling auton"},{"id":"p16s9","text":"omous model error recovery."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"### 1. 🗄️ Retool-Style CRUD Admin Dashboard Studio (`lib/crud.js` / Tool 26)
- **Instant Data Grids*"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"*: Generates full-featured data management micro-apps with live search, column sorting, and status f"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"ilter pills (`Active`, `Pending`, `Suspended`).
- **Interactive Modals**: Form validation for creati"},{"id":"p17s4","text":"ng and editing records on the fly.
- **Persistent Database**: Automatically syncs record changes to "},{"id":"p17s5","text":"`localStorage` so data survives page reloads.
- **CSV Data Export**: 1-click export of table data di"},{"id":"p17s6","text":"rectly to downloadable `.csv` files."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"### 2. ⏳ Time-Travel Debugger & History Timeline Scrubber (`lib/timetravel.js` / Tool 27)
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"## 🔒 Security & Sandboxing Architecture"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"Live Canvas operates with enterprise-grade defensive sandboxing:
- **Strict Path Sandboxing (`resolv"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"eSafePath`)**: All file access requests via API and agent tools (`live_canvas_preview`, `/dsh-live-c"},{"id":"p20s3","text":"anvas/api/open-file`, `/dsh-live-canvas/api/workspace/files`) must resolve within authorized workspa"},{"id":"p20s4","text":"ce roots (`workspaceRoots` or the current process working directory). Attempts to traverse into sens"},{"id":"p20s5","text":"itive parent directories (such as `/etc`, system binaries, or sibling folders) are rejected with `ER"},{"id":"p20s6","text":"R_PATH_OUTSIDE_ROOTS` and HTTP 403 Forbidden.
- **CSRF & Origin Verification (`isTrustedRequest`)**:"},{"id":"p20s7","text":" Mutating endpoints require verified same-origin requests matching standard browser headers (`Sec-Fe"},{"id":"p20s8","text":"tch-Site: same-origin`, `Origin`, or `Referer`) or loopback authorization.
- **Content Security Poli"},{"id":"p20s9","text":"cy**: Canvas previews are rendered inside sandboxed iframes with strict CSP directives (`default-src"},{"id":"p20s10","text":" 'self' 'unsafe-inline' 'unsafe-eval' data: blob: https: http:; X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN; X-Conte"},{"id":"p20s11","text":"nt-Type-Options: nosniff`).
- **DOM Attribute Escaping & Scoped Frame Messaging**: Projects Hub sani"},{"id":"p20s12","text":"tizes all `data-file-path`, `data-title`, and `data-path` attributes via `escapeHtml` (supporting fi"},{"id":"p20s13","text":"lenames with quotes and special characters) and restricts parent frame `postMessage` delivery to exp"},{"id":"p20s14","text":"licit `targetOrigin` (`window.location.origin`).
- **Comprehensive Route Family Protection & Volatil"},{"id":"p20s15","text":"e Reactivity**: All registered route families (`/events`, `/sandbox`, `/diff`, `/matrix`, `/timetrav"},{"id":"p20s16","text":"el`, `/assets`, `/api`, and updater status) are guarded by `isTrustedRequest` / `isTrustedStatusRequ"},{"id":"p20s17","text":"est`, rejecting untrusted LAN or cross-site requests with 403 Forbidden. Runtime configuration chang"},{"id":"p20s18","text":"es via Cordis `loader/volatile-update` and `config` events are dynamically observed and applied live"},{"id":"p20s19","text":" to store, watcher, and tools without restarting the harness."}],"truncated":true}
